module.name: Error Handler Plugin
module.doc:description: This module provides common error handling for APIs

parameter.name: badRequestError
parameter.defaultValue: There was an issue with your request

parameter.name: unauthorizedError
parameter.defaultValue: Authentication was not provided or is invalid

parameter.name: forbiddenError
parameter.defaultValue: You are not allowed to make this request

parameter.name: methodNotAllowedError
parameter.defaultValue: The method is not allowed on the resource

parameter.name: notAcceptableError
parameter.defaultValue: The API cannot provide the requested accepted response

parameter.name: timeoutError
parameter.defaultValue: The request to the server has been timed-out

parameter.name: tooManyRequestsError
parameter.defaultValue: You have made too many requests to the server

parameter.name: expressionError
parameter.defaultValue: Error with data transformation. See log for details.

parameter.name: notImplementedError
parameter.defaultValue: The operation has not been implemented

parameter.name: previousError
parameter.summary: Script to generate the previous error message. Usually pulled from the external system's response in the error object. Set empty string to ignore previous errors.

parameter.name: responseKey
parameter.summary: The response key name to which to add the error payload. Set empty string to set the payload as the root element.

parameter.name: resolveNestedErrors
parameter.summary: When true, composite/wrapper errors (Scatter-Gather, Parallel For-Each, Until-Successful, VM publish-consume, Validation All) resolve to the mapping of the standard error(s) nested inside them; with mixed nested errors the highest status code wins. The wrapper's own mapping is the fallback when no nested error resolves.

parameter.name: propagateStatusCode
parameter.summary: When true and the error type has no mapping (would return 500), the downstream response status code and reason phrase (error.errorMessage.attributes) are used instead. Covers statuses without a dedicated Mule error type, e.g. 422. An explicit mapping, including a custom MULE:UNKNOWN entry, always wins.

mule:set-variable.value: #[output application/java import getErrorTypeAsString, evalOrElse from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- evalOrElse(() -> getErrorTypeAsString(vars.error.errorType), 'UNKNOWN')]
mule:set-variable.doc:name: Error Type

mule:set-variable.value: #[output application/java import evalOrElse from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- evalOrElse(() -> vars.error.description, '')]
mule:set-variable.doc:name: Safe Error Description

mule:logger.message: #[output application/java --- "Error type: " ++ (vars.errorType default "") ++ " Error Description: " ++ (vars.safeDescription default "")]

mule:set-variable.value: #[output application/java import getError, resolveNestedErrorMapping, resolveStatusCodePassthrough from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- (if (vars.resolveNestedErrors default false) resolveNestedErrorMapping(vars.error, vars.defaultErrors, vars.customErrors default {}) else null) default (if (vars.propagateStatusCode default false) resolveStatusCodePassthrough(vars.error, vars.defaultErrors, vars.customErrors default {}) else null) default getError(vars.errorType, vars.defaultErrors, vars.customErrors default {})]
mule:set-variable.doc:name: Error Definition

mule:logger.message: #[output application/java --- "Error HTTP Status: $(attributes.httpStatus default 500) Error Response: $(write(payload, "application/json") default "")"]

ee:message.ee:set-attributes: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { httpStatus: 500, errorLog : "Error Handler Plugin fatal fallback" }
